binary.description: Executable or harness path DWARF invokes for this target.

implementation.description: Real node implementation exercised by this target.

language.description: Implementation language used to select compatible harness and instrumentation paths.

x-ui-option-descriptions.rust: Target or harness is compiled from Rust.
x-ui-option-descriptions.haskell: Target or harness is compiled from Haskell.

input_format.description: How generated input is delivered to the target process.

x-ui-option-descriptions.stdin_bytes: Write the generated bytes directly to standard input.
x-ui-option-descriptions.file_path: Write generated bytes to a file and supply its path using the target's configured file interface.
x-ui-option-descriptions.file_arg: Write generated bytes to a file and pass the path as a positional argument.
x-ui-option-descriptions.argv: Pass the generated value directly as command-line arguments.

decoder_type.description: Executable parser, protocol, or instrumented node-library surface represented by this target.

x-ui-option-descriptions.CBOR codec: Drive a CBOR parser or codec directly with generated bytes.
x-ui-option-descriptions.Mini-protocol decoder: Drive a Cardano mini-protocol message decoder or state-machine surface.
x-ui-option-descriptions.Coverage-guided AFL++ harness (native Sa: Run an AFL++ harness compiled with native SanitizerCoverage feedback.

enum: UNBUILT - Haskell shim skeleton exists; cabal deps need wiring
status.description: Explicit implementation-readiness note for targets that cannot currently execute.

x-ui-option-descriptions.UNBUILT - Haskell shim skeleton exists;: The Haskell harness skeleton exists, but required Cabal dependencies are not connected yet.

upstream_commit.description: Exact upstream source revision represented by the target binary. For a new runnable target, use the full upstream Git commit SHA.

invariants.description: Safety or correctness properties expected to hold for every generated input.

expected_outcomes.description: Mapping from process results to DWARF outcome classes such as ok, clean_error, and crash.

source_caveat.description: Known limitation explaining what source path or behavior this target does not represent.
